sentences.text: The brief fact as reflected from record is that the petitioner's land was acquired by the respondent No.1 in the year 2016 and Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:1599 award was passed.

The petitioner was not satisfied with the quantum of the compensation, therefore, he moved an application before the Arbitrator ie. Additional Commissioner, Bilaspur for enhancement which was allowed on 28.01.2020.

Against that order, the respondent has preferred an application u/s. 34 of Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 before the District Judge, Raigarh which is registered as Misc. Civil Case No. MJC Civil/62/2021.

entities.text: Misc. Civil Case No. MJC Civil/62/2021
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
The case is pending since 12.04.2021.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the application filed on 12.04.2021 is still pending and more than two years has already been lapsed and the same has not been decided and would for issuance of direction to decide the same expeditiously.

4. Considering the submission made by learned counsel for the petitioner and also considering the fact that the application is still pending for more than two years, therefore, the learned District Judge is directed to make an endeavor to complete the proceeding within an outer limit of four months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
5. Accordingly, the instant writ petition stands disposed of.
